name: freshframe
description: Fresh Frame — website. React client + Node mail API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
